verdict.rationale: CRA's pre-flow overview pages state some prerequisites up front: temporary-SIN holders must use BRO, EFILE filers sign in with an EFILE number and password, and representatives must request access through the Represent a Client portal. Nothing in the pack lays out the full chain of account creation, credentials and identity-proofing steps a founder must clear before filing. missing for 10: a published end-to-end list of account, credential and identity-verification steps before filing, identity-proofing method details (e.g., verification codes or sign-in options), and hands-on corroboration that no steps surface mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Individuals with a temporary SIN that starts with 9 must now use BRO to register for a BN and most CRA program accounts.
Use your EFILE number and password to: Maintain your account, Renew your account, View transmission history
representatives will need to use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account.
